messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Bioconda: Version 1.6.3 missing
parts: Hi, the newest version is not available via Bioconda yet, even though it was published almost two months ago. I am wondering whom to ask in order to do that? Thanks!

messages.author: f24b6672b86b41b4
messages.subject: Re: Bioconda: Version 1.6.3 missing
parts:
Hi Christian,

The recipes for bioconda are maintained at https://github.com/bioconda/bioconda-recipes.

The latest version of Subread is 1.6.2:

https://github.com/bioconda/bioconda-recipes/blob/c28dc49162a78784816a5c12f0aa1ae328974007/recipes/subread/meta.yaml#L7

If you're comfortable writing conda recipes (or interested in learning), you can fork the repository, update the recipe, and send a pull request. If not, I can attempt to update the recipe later today.

John

messages.author: f24b6672b86b41b4
messages.subject: Re: Bioconda: Version 1.6.3 missing
parts:
I updated the recipe and submitted a Pull Request. I'll post here when Subread 1.6.3 is available on bioconda.

https://github.com/bioconda/bioconda-recipes/pull/12425

John

messages.author: f24b6672b86b41b4
messages.subject: Re: Bioconda: Version 1.6.3 missing
parts:
Subread 1.6.3 is now available for download from Anaconda Cloud.

https://anaconda.org/bioconda/subread/files?version=1.6.3

conda install -c bioconda subread

John

messages.author: 5bb3db725cc5d6fa
messages.subject: Re: Bioconda: Version 1.6.3 missing
parts: Thanks so much John, I did not know how this worked! I just tested and it worked fine, I got 1.6.3 now ;)
